decoder_breakdown.provenance: Decoder-only breakdown reconstructed from a post-norm-fusion kernel profile plus the measured 2.7 s norm-fusion saving; total 10.1 s, separate from the 10.5 s generation-path decode.

latency.metric: CUPTI kernel span, median, CUDA graph replay

nvfp4.arithmetic: FP64 transforms/contraction/reconstruction; both operands NVFP4; no product/output rounding

channel_grouping_3d.arithmetic: BF16 source, FP64 direct reference; FP32 coefficients/transforms/dequantized GEMM/reconstruction; NVFP4 operands; FP32 M; reported errors before final BF16 output rounding

spatial_sweep.metric: CUPTI median first-to-last kernel span, microseconds

spatial_cost_model.traffic_note: Writing and reading V and M doubles the workspace byte count before cache effects. Footprint is not traffic.
spatial_cost_model.transform_count_note: Illustrative point sets and unfactored matrix evaluation in the analytic model; not the optimized implementation coefficients.

b300_strong_scaling.hardware: same eight-B300 node for all GPU counts

frame_buffer_capacity.source_precision: rounded values in implementation PR; raw per-capacity result files unavailable

fusion_measurements.source_precision: incremental full-model measurements; saved base commit does not identify each modified kernel snapshot

nvfp4_model_comparison.latents: FP32 Wan VAE encoding, rounded once to BF16 and shared by all decoders
nvfp4_model_comparison.reference: FP32 Wan VAE on identical BF16 latents
nvfp4_model_comparison.nvfp4_recipe: dynamic runtime activation scaling; production loader default convolution selection; no calibrated ModelOpt scales
nvfp4_model_comparison.timing: median CUPTI first-kernel start to last-kernel end
nvfp4_model_comparison.peak_memory: first untimed accuracy call before timing warmup; includes live model/input, lazy weight packing, and any first-call autotuning allocations; allocated bytes / 2**30, not steady-state-only, reserved capacity, or graph-capture peak

hardware_b300.metric: CUPTI first-to-last kernel median; step_ms for the steady-state two-latent-frame step
